about.en: NVIDIA bStock (NVDAB) is a tokenized share of NVIDIA Corporation issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle registered in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0x02fca66c1d1afb4e2a7884261eb00f63598a7436, backed 1:1 by NVDA shares held in segregated custody. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership of the shares.
